title: board.setup_flows: a module's guided setup, rendered by the board at #/setup/<module> (one flow per module, plus an optional `mode: advanced` one), only where the owner must make something elsewhere first (an OAuth client, an app, a token, a bot) pair a channel, or choose a mode. A plain sign-in is a board.signins entry: one Connect, its per-install values inline. Compile adds `module`, `fields` (each secret's label, pattern and help, from its `setup:`) and, with a pair_url, `pair_token` (the name of the generated secret <module>_pair_token the board sends as bearer) and a network between the board and that service.

order.description: where it sits among the flows, lowest first

why.description: one sentence: what the person gets

effort.description: e.g. about 2 minutes, needs the Telegram app

mode.description: basic (the default): the module's own setup, usually a sign-in; done once it is connected (and paired, if it pairs). advanced: the optional second flow, 'your own app' for more, shown under the basic one; done once its secrets exist (and it is paired, if it pairs); its services start once their secrets exist

capabilities.description: advanced only: what the person's own app unlocks, one short phrase each (a bot people can DM, live events)

admin.description: who else may need to approve, plainly (your Slack admin may need to approve the app)

steps.description: markdown; {board_url} becomes the board's own address (where its sign-ins return), {redirect_url} the exact redirect the flow's sign-in sends (what a hand-made client must list), {scopes} the console_scopes (one per line), and inline code gets a copy button. With `ways`, these are the intro shown above the choices

console_scopes.description: the scopes the steps tell the owner to add on the vendor's consent screen: the one place to change them; `{scopes}` in the steps (or a way's steps) becomes this list

ways.description: alternative ways to get what the paste fields ask for (an OAuth client): the owner picks one and only that way's steps show

detail.description: one plain line under the title

effort.description: shown beside the page title while this way is picked

organisation.description: this way is picking the organisation (modules/marketplace.json organisations) whose app fills the paste fields; offered only when the catalog lists one for this module, and suggested when the owner's email matches it

paste.description: this way ends in the paste fields

domains.description: suggested (and preselected) when the owner's email is at one of these domains

secrets.description: names of this module's secrets with `setup:`, shown as paste fields in this order

choose.description: a module with modes: the owner picks one first, which sets this module setting (a settings change, applied like any: the owner's Approvals) and, for an option, the extra settings it names; the flow's Connect opens once the setting holds the pick. Nothing is filed when the pick is what the setting already is

setting.description: one of this module's settings with `values`

detail.description: what it means and what it needs, plainly

otherwise.description: shown, and the option unavailable, while the instance does not set it

requires.description: an instance setting the option needs

when.description: setting: value or [values]; asked only while the instance's settings hold

signin.description: an id from this module's board.signins: its connect button

pair_url.description: the pairing endpoint of one of this module's services

connect_url.description: a connect path the board already serves for a connection that is not a board.signins entry: its Connect button; done once that connection is signed in

console_url.description: the vendor's page where the owner makes the client this flow's secrets ask for: a button beside the steps
